fusions.name: Spawning Tide
fusions.desc: Throws a bead of reef water that deals 12 damage, leaves the target [Soaked] for 6 seconds and cuts it, leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Reef Bloom
fusions.desc: A strike of grown reef that deals 26 damage, ignores armour and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction already on the target (max 40%).

fusions.name: Lime Crust
fusions.desc: Crusts your feathers in lime: your armour rises by 25% for 10 seconds, and you take 15% less water damage.

fusions.name: Growth Rings
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once into a shield that soaks 5% of your maximum health per stack (39% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds. You regenerate 0.4 health a second at all times.
